choices: A gyre goes by the right shoulder, facing each other, with no hands.

figures.text: half poussette - larks pull partners back then left | larks backing up, poussette ¾ till larks are back to back in the center
neighbors box the gnat - robins are now back to back
neighbors gyre ½ to trade places **right-2-3-4-5-6**
larks gyre left shoulders ½ to face your partner **left-2-3-4**-5-6
partners gyre once and end in waltz position
